description: Points a subdomain (for example willow.example.com) at the load balancer of the Willow MCP gateway that the domain owner runs in their own cloud. DNS only: proxying breaks MCP streaming.
variableDescription: %target%: hostname of the customer's own load balancer that serves the Willow gateway (for example k8s-willow-0123456789.elb.us-east-1.amazonaws.com)
